purpose: This table is a small reference dimension of airline carriers, mapping each two-letter carrier code to its full legal airline name, intended to feed joins from flight or booking fact tables that only carry the carrier code.
usage: Join downstream fact tables to this table on carrier to resolve the human-readable airline name; both carrier and name are populated for every row (null_rate 0.0) so no null-handling logic is required by consumers.
limitations: The table is tiny (row_count 16) and was observed with zero duplicate rows and zero nulls in this profile snapshot, so no deduplication or null-tolerance logic was built in; consumers should be aware this cleanup reflects only the columns and values present in this single profiling run, and any newly added carriers would need re-profiling.
